calibration.objective: predicted Top COC vs measured Top COC (measured-time interpolation)

sample_prediction.insulated_geometry: LEGACY_INSULATED_LAYERS (3 mm sealed air + 200 um PDMS); forward extension only, not independently validated
sample_prediction.interpretation: model-predicted sample temperature; Top COC external validation does not directly validate the sample layer

major_limitation: 72C protocol shows a larger cooling-phase mismatch (cooling RMSE ~4.09 C); documented reduced-order transient limitation; parameters not altered to improve it.

scientific_status.insulated_model: forward extension using 3 mm sealed air + 200 um PDMS; not independently validated
scientific_status.sample_temperature: model-predicted hidden thermal state, not directly measured

architecture: measured internal temperature -> 1D multilayer FDM + convection + nonlinear radiation -> raw Top COC -> output-side effective lag tau_top -> predicted measured Top COC
freeze_rule: Any future change to k, cp, tau, h, epsilon, geometry, or lag placement must constitute a new model version rather than silently modifying V1.
